column1: # The CI gate's baseline (ADR-0014, section 4, "Regressions"): for each
# workload, Rust's time over Go's in the bench ledger's first entry
# the pooled ratios of the entry "The secret paths at dcroxide `2074168`"
# (k256's basepoint table, a lasting gain). `purse-bench drive --gate`
# fails when a session's ratio is more than twice its baseline. Lower a
# value when a ledger entry records a lasting gain; never raise one to make
# a red gate green without a ledger entry that explains why.
# Left out: the memory-bound derivations (snacl.derive, kdf.*), whose ratio
# depends on the runner's memory system and core count, and mix.*, whose
# Go side needs FLINT, which CI's runner does not have.
# hd.xpub_string and hd.parse_xpub cycle through 16,384 different inputs;
# their baselines below were measured when they repeated one input (the
# decode and extended-key rows one string, the encode row 256 hashes that
# differ in their last byte only), and stand until a ledger entry measures
# the cycling rows. crypto.base58check_decode_one, the decode row as it was,
